title: Count connected islands
summary: Count groups of orthogonally connected land cells in a rectangular character grid.
requirements: The grid is a rectangular array of rows; each row is an array of strings "1" (land) or "0" (water).
Cells connect vertically or horizontally, not diagonally.
Do not mutate the input grid.
hints: Scan the grid for land not previously visited.
For each new island, explore its neighbors with DFS or BFS.
Use a visited structure or a copied grid so the original grid is preserved.
